text:
Maria (Finance): Quick flag 12k negative line on April AWS Marketplace invoice labeled 'promo_applied' (INV-2027-04-1023). Not in our promo log. Anyone see this?
billing-bot: Invoice INV-2027-04-1023 posted · total $54,210 · adjustments: -$12,200 (promo_applied)
Arjun (Billing Ops): Pulled CSV, line L-0099 shows -12200 with code PROMO_AUTO. No matching internal promo. Could be merchant mapping or partner credit.
Jenna (Accountant): Material amount. I'll suspend revenue recognition for that invoice until resolved. Please capture AR impact in FIN-3312.
Sam (Cloud Partnerships): Checking contract: partners absorb credits up to $3k qtr. This is >$12k so suspect AWS applied a marketplace promo incorrectly. I'll contact AWS rep.
Arjun (Billing Ops): Opening AWS support case now. Case #987654321. Message: 'Unexpected marketplace promo applied to vendor invoice. Request reversal or corrected invoice and audit trail.' Attached invoice PDF and CSV snippet.
Maria (Finance): Uploaded reconciliation sheet: https://redwood-internal.app/fin/reconciliations/INV-2027-04-1023.csv. Filing FIN-3312.
Sam (Cloud Partnerships): AWS replied: 'Looking into tenant tag mapping; possible promo propagation error. ETA 2 business days for a correction.'
Jenna (Accountant): Good. Once we have corrected invoice, I'll update revenue and cash entries. If AWS refuses, we need partner confirmation in writing that they absorbed promo.
Arjun (Billing Ops): I'll monitor and post updates here. If no reply in 48h, escalate to TAM.
Maria (Finance): Thanks team  marking owner @Arjun. (reaction: :eyes:)
